verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents a public API for programmatic database management (planetscale-docs-49), plus a CLI with non-interactive scripting support explicitly for agents/scripts (planetscale-docs-17), and llms.txt is live (planetscale-probe-1). This gives AI-native users multiple documented, scriptable interfaces beyond just a UI. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found all candidate paths 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of API usage by third parties.
